epic.title: #441 transactional binding store
epic.intent_and_why: Close the spine-rail binding registry's lost-update/torn-write race under concurrent PostToolUse claim/release and SessionStart writers, unify rail/gauge acting-agent identity validation, and conservatively reap dead binding entries -- without touching checklist-engine lifecycle, journal, child, actor/PID, or durable-root behavior.

definition_of_done: The transactional binding store is implemented, proven red-to-green against reviewed base 065445de, independently reviewed (APPROVE), and integrated with 0 failures on the focused suites and the full non-Windows suite.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Strict contracts: stable sibling lock covers load->safe reap->one mutation->unique-temp atomic replace for all three writers; bounded fail-open on any lock/filesystem failure; readable active leases never age-reaped.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: A real spawned multiprocessing.get_context('spawn') production topology (not threads, not a mock) proving red on reviewed base and green after the fix, plus five named lock/adapter failure tests and a mixed-writer (claim + SessionStart) race proof.
good_enough.appetite: One bounded Commander execute gate (g1), four files.

hard_constraints: Never reap a readable active lease by age.
Stdlib only; hooks stay fail-open and bounded.
fixed_decisions: Full read-reap-mutate-replace transaction owned by spine_rail.py, not per-writer locks.
Stable non-replaced sibling lock file (never the registry inode os.replace targets).
spine_rail.is_usable_agent_id is the sole 1-64 ASCII alnum/_/- identity predicate; gauge delegates to it.
24-hour missing-target reap grace and a short named lock retry budget.

current_wave.objective: Implement and prove the transactional binding store contract end to end.
exit_criteria: test_spawn_binding_transaction_red_green passes GREEN after RED was proven against reviewed base 065445de.
The five named lock/adapter failure tests pass.
An independent reviewer returns verdict APPROVE.
Focused suites and the full non-Windows suite pass with 0 failures.

Identity unified on spine_rail.is_usable_agent_id (gauge delegates). Claim targets validated for containment, readability, and symlink-escape. Integrated: 5 named lock/adapter tests, focused suites (193 passed/1 skipped), and the full non-Windows suite (3015 passed/6 skipped/0 failed/1130 subtests) all green.

wave_evidence.claim: The pre-#441 binding store loses updates under concurrent writers.
wave_evidence.expected: A lost update (a subset of expected entries survives).
wave_evidence.observed: Stronger than expected: 16 spawned production claim writers against reviewed base 065445de produced a TORN WRITE (json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Extra data) on one run and a straightforward lost update (2/16 survived) on another -- both prove the defect, the torn-write form is more severe than the plan's stated premise.

wave_evidence.claim: The transaction closes the race: all three writers now serialize through one stable-lock seam.
wave_evidence.expected: 16/16 spawned claim-writer entries survive; a mixed claim+SessionStart race also survives in full.
wave_evidence.observed: test_spawn_binding_transaction_red_green: 16/16 survived, re-run 3x stable. test_spawn_binding_sessionstart_claim_mixed_writer_race: 16/16 survived (8 claim + 8 SessionStart-resume), re-run 3x stable.
